title: Only 10.6% of US Money Is Actual Cash. The Rest? #shorts
description:
Out of $23.4 trillion in the US money supply (M2, September 2026), physical cash is about $2.5 trillion: roughly 1 dollar in 10. The rest is numbers in bank accounts, and most of it was created by banks when they made loans.
Full video on the Coin Theory channel.

Data: FRED M2SL and WCURCIR (currency in circulation); Bank of England, "Money creation in the modern economy" (2014).

This video is for education only and is not financial advice.
Original script and animation. Narrated with an AI voice.
